scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
scripts.ci:fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.docs: mkdir -p docs && npm run docs:stores && npm run docs:composables && npm run docs:utils && npm run docs:editor && npm run docs:tts && npm run docs:ai && npm run docs:cards && npm run docs:files && npm run docs:jobs && npm run docs:mcp && npm run docs:platform && npm run docs:components && npm run docs:router && npm run docs:types
scripts.docs:jobs: mkdir -p docs && documentation build src/jobs/index.js src/jobs/*.js -f md > docs/jobs.md && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/jobs.md
scripts.docs:mcp: mkdir -p docs && documentation build src/mcp/index.js src/mcp/*.js -f md > docs/mcp.md && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/mcp.md
scripts.docs:platform: mkdir -p docs && documentation build src/platform/index.js src/platform/*.js -f md > docs/platform.md && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/platform.md
scripts.docs:files: mkdir -p docs && documentation build src/files/index.js src/files/*.js -f md > docs/files.md && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/files.md
scripts.docs:stores: mkdir -p docs && documentation build src/stores/index.js src/stores/*.js src/stores/migrations/*.js -f md > docs/stores.md && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/stores.md
scripts.docs:composables: mkdir -p docs && documentation build src/composables/index.js src/composables/*.js -f md > docs/composables.md && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/composables.md
scripts.docs:utils: mkdir -p docs && documentation build src/utils/index.js src/utils/*.js -f md > docs/utils.md && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/utils.md
scripts.docs:editor: mkdir -p docs && documentation build src/editor/index.js src/editor/*.js -f md > docs/editor.md && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/editor.md
scripts.docs:tts: mkdir -p docs && documentation build src/tts/index.js src/tts/*.js -f md > docs/tts.md && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/tts.md
scripts.docs:ai: mkdir -p docs && documentation build src/ai/index.js src/ai/*.js src/ai/context/*.js src/ai/profiles/*.js src/ai/prompts/*.js src/ai/skills/*.js src/ai/skills/*/*.js src/ai/tools/*.js src/ai/tools/data/*.js -f md > docs/ai.md 2>/dev/null && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/ai.md
scripts.docs:cards: mkdir -p docs && documentation build src/cards/index.js src/cards/*.js -f md > docs/cards.md && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/cards.md
scripts.docs:components: mkdir -p docs && { documentation build src/components/index.js src/components/**/*.js src/components/**/*.vue -f md > docs/components.md 2>/dev/null && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/components.md; } || true
scripts.docs:router: mkdir -p docs && documentation build src/router/index.js -f md > docs/router.md && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/router.md
scripts.docs:types: mkdir -p docs && documentation build src/types/index.js src/types/*.js -f md > docs/types.md && prettier --write --log-level warn docs/types.md
scripts.docs:html: documentation build src/stores/*.js src/composables/*.js src/utils/*.js src/components/**/*.js src/router/*.js src/types/*.js -f html -o docs/api
